metadata.title: Final Privacy Claims Audit & Threat Model Verification
metadata.project: Secure FHIR-Based Federated Learning with Differential Privacy and Paillier Secure Aggregation
metadata.auditor: Senior Full-Stack & ML Information Security Research Engineer

mechanism_code_trace.transcript_logging_audit: backend/app/core/logging.py & audit_logger: Logs record only high-level metadata (client ID, execution time, round index, loss). Parameter weights and update vectors are strictly excluded from logs.

threat_model_matrix.role: Honest-but-Curious Aggregation Server (without Paillier Private Key)
threat_model_matrix.observable_transcript: Paillier ciphertexts [[hat{Delta}_i]] for all clients i in {1..K} and rounds t in {1..T}.
threat_model_matrix.compromise_capabilities: Follows protocol honestly; analyzes incoming ciphertexts. Lacks private key.
threat_model_matrix.confidentiality_guarantee: CRYPTOGRAPHICALLY PROTECTED. Paillier PHE IND-CPA security ensures zero plaintext visibility into individual hospital parameter updates.
threat_model_matrix.privacy_guarantee: Cryptographic confidentiality of individual vectors. DP applies only to downstream released outputs.

threat_model_matrix.role: Untrusted / Malicious Server Possessing or Controlling Paillier Private Key
threat_model_matrix.observable_transcript: Decrypted individual noisy parameter updates hat{Delta}_i = tilde{Delta}_i + eta_i for each client i.
threat_model_matrix.compromise_capabilities: Uses Paillier private key to decrypt individual client payloads before aggregation.
threat_model_matrix.confidentiality_guarantee: ZERO CONFIDENTIALITY. Paillier provides zero privacy against an entity possessing the private key.
threat_model_matrix.privacy_guarantee: FALLBACK TO LOCAL DP. Protected ONLY by client-level Gaussian perturbation: epsilon = 41,357.23 (bounded update) or 162,714.46 (replacement). Mandatory mitigation: Segregated Key Authority or (t, n) Threshold Paillier.

threat_model_matrix.observable_transcript: Network packets in transit between clients and coordinator.
threat_model_matrix.compromise_capabilities: Passively intercepts or actively monitors transmission channels.
threat_model_matrix.confidentiality_guarantee: FULLY SECURE. Double encapsulation: Transport Layer Security (TLS 1.3) + application-layer Paillier ciphertexts. Plaintext exposure is zero.

threat_model_matrix.role: Consortium Analyst / Downstream Consumer of Released Global Model
threat_model_matrix.observable_transcript: Released global model parameter deltas Delta_global^(t) for all T=8 rounds.
threat_model_matrix.compromise_capabilities: Observes global model weights, tracks trajectories, performs membership or property inference.
threat_model_matrix.confidentiality_guarantee: PUBLIC / NON-CONFIDENTIAL. Global model is intentionally published across consortium nodes.
threat_model_matrix.privacy_guarantee: FORMAL GAUSSIAN MECHANISM DP. Bounded by accumulated noise variance: epsilon = 14,116.93 (add/remove adjacency) or 54,900.53 (replacement adjacency).

view3_released_aggregate_add_remove.adjacency: Add/Remove Client (or null-baseline participation): D' = D \ {D_j}

view3_released_aggregate_replacement.adjacency: Replacement Client (worst-case diametrically opposite delta): D_j -> D_j'

view1_single_client_server_bounded.adjacency: Bounded client delta (relative to null update 0): ||tilde{Delta}_i|| <= C

claims_audit_matrix.claimed_scope: Guarantees formal (epsilon, delta)-DP for participating hospital clients under K=3 federated aggregation.
claims_audit_matrix.empirical_evidence: Gaussian noise is injected into clipped updates. For the released aggregate, the effective noise multiplier sigma_eff = sigma * sqrt(3) = 0.01732 yields mathematically verified epsilon = 14,116.93 (delta=1e-5) under add/remove client adjacency.
claims_audit_matrix.formal_qualification: CONDITIONALLY VALID because epsilon = 14,116.93 represents an empirical gradient perturbation regime that mitigates reconstruction, NOT cryptographic indistinguishability (since exp(14116.93) is astronomical). Must be reported transparently as empirical noise perturbation.

claims_audit_matrix.claimed_scope: Guarantees individual patient activity records cannot be inferred from trained models.
claims_audit_matrix.empirical_evidence: Local training in client nodes executes standard Adam SGD over 12 epochs without per-example gradient clipping or sample-level Poisson subsampling.
claims_audit_matrix.formal_qualification: UNSUPPORTED. Client clipping bounds the aggregate parameter update across an entire client's dataset, but does NOT bound individual patient contribution. Record-level privacy is mathematically unbounded and cannot be claimed.

claims_audit_matrix.claim_title: Paillier Confidentiality of Individual Client Updates
claims_audit_matrix.claimed_scope: Prevents the aggregation server from observing individual hospital parameter updates.
claims_audit_matrix.empirical_evidence: Paillier encryption correctly wraps parameter updates into ciphertexts, and aggregation occurs via homomorphic multiplication in ciphertext space.
claims_audit_matrix.formal_qualification: CONDITIONALLY VALID: Valid in a production architecture where the private key is held by an independent Key Authority or distributed via (t,n) Threshold Paillier. In the laptop prototype where the coordinator generates and holds both public and private keys, the server theoretically has decryption capability. The paper must specify this trust assumption.

claims_audit_matrix.claimed_scope: Paillier encryption protects the trained global model from being observed.
claims_audit_matrix.empirical_evidence: The coordinator explicitly decrypts the aggregated sum and publishes the resulting global model weights to all consortium clients at the end of each round.
claims_audit_matrix.formal_qualification: FALSE. The global model is intentionally released and plaintext-accessible across the consortium. Paillier protects only in-transit individual client updates during aggregation.

claims_audit_matrix.claim_title: Resistance to Model Inversion and Gradient Leakage (DLG)
claims_audit_matrix.claimed_scope: The system prevents Deep Leakage from Gradients (DLG) and reconstruction attacks.
claims_audit_matrix.empirical_evidence: Perturbing all 11,206 weights with Gaussian noise (std 0.08) degrades gradient-matching optimization in DLG and prevents exact input reconstruction.
claims_audit_matrix.formal_qualification: CONDITIONALLY VALID: While the perturbation mathematically impairs analytical gradient inversion, the codebase does not run an empirical DLG/iDLG reconstruction experiment to measure peak SNR or MSE. The claim should be framed as heuristic resistance.

claims_audit_matrix.claim_title: Numerical Equivalence Between Plaintext and Paillier Aggregation
claims_audit_matrix.claimed_scope: Paillier encryption preserves exact numerical accuracy compared with plaintext aggregation.
claims_audit_matrix.empirical_evidence: Controlled experiments across seeds 42, 43, 44 show identical test set accuracy: 68.74% plaintext vs 68.74% encrypted (0.0000% delta). Round-by-round vector comparison shows max absolute error <= 4.93e-7 and relative error <= 3.54e-6.
claims_audit_matrix.formal_qualification: FULLY VERIFIED. 6-decimal fixed-point encoding is exact within floating-point precision.

claims_audit_matrix.claimed_scope: 512-bit Paillier keys provide sufficient cryptographic security for real-world healthcare deployment.
claims_audit_matrix.empirical_evidence: 512-bit RSA/Paillier moduli can be factored using the General Number Field Sieve (GNFS) in under a few core-years on academic hardware.
claims_audit_matrix.formal_qualification: FALSE. NIST SP 800-57 Part 1 Rev 5 mandates >= 2048-bit keys for current deployments and 3072-bit keys beyond 2030. The 512-bit key is strictly a performance prototype to enable fast simulation on consumer hardware.

evaluation_sigma_001.finding: Subsampling reduces epsilon from 41,357 to 208.43, but epsilon=208 is still mathematically unbounded. Subsampling alone CANNOT achieve formal DP without raising sigma.

evaluation_sigma_050.finding: Combines with moderate noise to achieve formal DP epsilon = 4.22 (delta=1e-5).

direction_2_dimension_reduction.setting: MLP compression from d = 11,206 to d = 500
direction_2_dimension_reduction.impact_on_epsilon: EXACTLY ZERO. Dimension d does not appear in Gaussian DP budget formulas. Epsilon is identical at d=500 and d=11,206.
direction_2_dimension_reduction.impact_on_snr_and_utility: CRITICAL UTILITY BENEFIT. Expected noise norm E[||eta||_2] decreases from 846.88 to 178.88 (a 4.73x / 78.9% reduction in perturbation magnitude), preventing accuracy collapse when formal privacy noise (sigma >= 0.50) is introduced.
